title: This Unique Photo-Memory Album Offers a Fascinating Window to Student Life at Cornell University from 1914 to 1918
author: Stan S. Katz
description: A Cornell University student created this album. Melvin Lorrel Nichols (1894-1981) was an undergrad from 1914-1918, and it is specifically those four years that his album meticulously depicts. It reveals an intimate and exciting view of co-educational college life, while at the same time gives a sense of the impact of WWI. Melvin would become a prominent member of the Cornell University Chemistry
